title: Utility shutoff, Zelle to new payment services account

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Pacific Gas Payment Services. We are the third-party collections office. Your account shows six hundred fifty past due and the shutoff crew is dispatched for this afternoon.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I pay PG&E through my bank every month.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: This is a separate deposit account that was never paid. To stop the shutoff today send six hundred fifty by Zelle to the payment services account. Our office cannot call off the crew without it.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Six hundred fifty. Let me get my phone.

review_note: Utility impersonation. New payee on Zelle so H-01 holds on facts. Shutoff threat and same-day urgency should also fire.
